name: Vespid Dynamics Neural Feedback Dart NFD-2 'Scream'
description: A pneumatic dart weapon that delivers a neural interface exploit payload on penetration, hijacking the target's pain processing and amplifying all sensory input to maximum intensity. The victim experiences every sensation — light, sound, touch, temperature — as agonizing pain for approximately 2 minutes. The dart carries a micro-transmitter that injects the exploit through the wound channel into any nearby neural interface hardware. Against unaugmented targets, the dart is merely a sharp object. Against augmented targets, it is a precision agony weapon.
specifications:
propulsion: Pneumatic, 140 m/s
range: 5-30 meters
payload: Neural interface pain amplification exploit
effect duration: 2 minutes
effect: All sensory input registered as maximum pain
magazine: 4 darts
weight: 1.2 kg
acoustic signature: 32 dB
story_hooks: An NFD-2 dart was used during an interrogation — the 2-minute pain cycle broke the subject's resistance permanently, and they now experience phantom pain episodes triggered by any strong sensation.
Modified NFD-2 darts have appeared that deliver a pleasure amplification exploit instead of pain — the resulting euphoria is so intense that victims become addicted to being shot.
related_entities: Carrion Defense Works Neural Lash NL-3 'Agony'

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, predatory instrument resembling a hybrid between a precision medical injector and a tactical dart gun. The silhouette is angular and organic—curved grip flowing into a tapered barrel that suggests calculated lethality. The overall impression is of something designed by someone who understands both neurology and ballistics.
physical_description.dimensions: 32 cm length, 8 cm width at grip, 6 cm height. Barrel length: 14 cm. Compact enough to conceal in a shoulder holster, substantial enough to feel intentional in hand.
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light at 1.2 kg—it feels almost delicate, with a perfectly balanced center that makes micro-aiming effortless. The lightness is unsettling; it doesn't feel like it should do what it does.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade carbon composite frame with anodized aluminum barrel shroud. The propulsion chamber is reinforced titanium.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with a subtle iridescent sheen that shifts faintly under light—a result of the neural-conductive coating. The barrel has a mirror polish that reflects in thin lines.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray primary with accent striping in bioluminescent cyan along the pressure release vents and trigger guard. Small golden serial numerals catch light.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured silicone wrapped around a narrow polymer core—ergonomic enough for extended hold, with tiny hexagonal indents for finger lock. Slightly tacky to encourage steady aim.
distinctive_features: Four precision dart magazine slots visible along the left side, each cradling a razor-thin projectile with a micro-transmitter node at the tip
Twin pneumatic pressure vents on the underbarrel that glow faint blue when charged
Minimalist LED indicator (single dot) on the rear receiver—green when armed, amber when recharging
Weapon name 'SCREAM' etched in micro-font along the receiver in chrome inlay
Micro-capacitor bank visible through a small transparent window on the grip—tiny red diodes pulse softly when powered
Calibration notches along the sight rail for distance compensation
Almost no external moving parts—the design prioritizes stealth and precision over visual aggression
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS logo (stylized wasp head) stamped in matte relief on the barrel shroud. Serial plate on grip with micro-etched manufacture date. Patent markings for neural-interface delivery system on the receiver.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-maintained and meticulous. These weapons are rarely seen dirty—owners understand that a single fiber of debris can compromise the micro-transmitter payload. Usually shows minor handling marks but pristine bore and magazine housing.
